evidence: Vulg. Ex. 31.10: vestēs sānctās in ministeriō Aaron sacerdōtī
terms.comment: The Vulgate’s phrase for the garments of Aaron’s priesthood. Eastern and Western vestments differ in cut and name (the phelonion and the chasuble, the epitrachelion and the stole), but the general word serves both.
Classical words (sacerdōtālis, Plin. Ep. 7.24.6, Lewis & Short); of a priest’s vestments only.

phrases.latin: induēturque stolā līneā et vestibus sānctīs
phrases.english: and he shall put on the linen robe and the holy vestments

sources: Lewis & Short: vestis · Lewis & Short: vestimentum · Lewis & Short: sacerdotalis · Lewis & Short: sanctus
